notes: Hardener changed no files; the change under review is commit 3667577 (src/cma/models.py, tests/test_models.py). Gaps for the owner: (1) README:68 still says 'Unmatched lines are OTHER'; design says OTHER now means 'unexplained money in' — wording update belongs with the categoriser/M16 rename task, not here. (2) No changelog exists, so there is no release-note line; decide whether one is wanted. (3) Rollback by revert is safe only while nothing assigns the new categories: once the categoriser emits e.g. cash_deposit into a checkpoint, the old Category enum would reject that value on resume. The design's rollback is CMA_RULESET=v1, which should be the documented path from that point; the later task introducing v2 should add a test for it. (4) tests/test_models.py's checkpoint test depends on langgraph internals (EXT_PYDANTIC_V2, ormsgpack layout); a langgraph upgrade may break the test without breaking resume. It skips only if langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite is missing, which CI installs via [durable].
